original_test_intent: Verify that each populated Type 17 record exposes the approved module manufacturer identity through a valid SMBIOS string reference, that empty/unknown records follow project policy, and that the per-locator identity remains stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 17 records and string areas, bind Manufacturer string index/value to locator, serial and part number, validate index/encoding and approved normalization, correlate a trusted inventory or SPD manufacturer identifier through an explicit mapping, and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the vendor inventory/normalization and reboot plan. No module manipulation or label inspection is intrinsic to the SMBIOS check.
required_inputs: Expected manufacturer per populated locator or approved module part
Policy for empty records, blank, Unknown, Not Specified and generic strings
Allowed case/spacing/legal-name aliases with raw-value preservation
Trusted inventory and JEDEC/SPD-to-vendor-name translation where used
Raw-capable parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and approved inventory; do not remove or replace DIMMs.
Validate that the Manufacturer string index is in range and retain raw bytes/value before normalization.
Do not equate an SPD numeric vendor identifier with a text string without an approved translation table.
Use locator plus serial/part number for identity; record order alone is insufficient.
Stop on invalid string index, ambiguous module mapping or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate per-record string reference/value, normalize approved aliases, correlate trusted module identity and compare pre/post reboot semantics.
Do not claim authenticity from a firmware string alone, alter hardware or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve per-locator manufacturer inventory, normalization and trusted identity mapping.
Approve reboot/recovery, assess ambiguous/generic values and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The displayed string is relevant, but grep -A1 loses locator/serial/part identity and cannot validate the raw string index or trusted vendor mapping.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 17 data and string areas; report locator/population, raw index/value, normalized manufacturer, serial/part identity and approved inventory/SPD comparison.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Manufacturer scope, Type 17 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing and memory changes are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate the SMBIOS string index/value for each stable locator/module identity, preserve raw text, apply only approved aliases and compare a trusted inventory or mapped SPD identifier before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 17 populated and represented empty memory-device records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and optional SPD decoder/database versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 Manufacturer string-index semantics and authoritative project inventory/vendor identifier source.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw string-table integrity, stable module identity, controlled normalization and explicit vendor-ID translation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects out-of-range/blank indices, wrong-slot vendor strings, alias drift and unsupported SPD-name equivalence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS and SPD are firmware/device-provided identity evidence, not cryptographic proof of module authenticity.

project_override_considerations: A project may allow supplier aliases or generic strings for empty slots, but must state exact conditions and retain raw values; an approved vendor list does not justify replacing the observed manufacturer.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/module identity, per-locator manufacturer and normalization/empty policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 17 records and string tables
Per-record locator/population, raw index/value, normalized manufacturer and serial/part linkage
Trusted inventory or mapped SPD vendor comparison with mapping/version
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot raw plus semantic manufacturer diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Manufacturer is a clear Type 17 string field; absent expected inventory is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: String-reference and inventory comparison are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds string-index integrity, stable module identity and controlled trusted-source mapping.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains per-locator normalization safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates metadata consistency from authenticity claims and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible vendor name from passing when its string reference is malformed, belongs to another locator or relies on an undocumented SPD-name mapping.
independent_technical_reasoning: String indices, values and module identity tuples are enumerable and software-comparable; approved normalization is an input rather than a manual core action.
